notes.general_comments:
This examination paper provided a difficult challenge to the candidates with some pleasing performances.
Thirteen questions can be said to have been found to be easier. 50% or more of candidates chose the
correct responses to each of Questions 1, 4, 10, 11, 12, 14, 18, 19, 23, 27, 28, 33, and 36. Eight questions
can be said to have been found to be particularly difficult. Less than 25% of candidates chose the correct
responses to each of Questions 2, 5, 9, 13, 21, 22, 29 and 40.
